issues.what: the rock is a smeared, wobbly procedural skin with no fractured ledges, cracks or blocky faces; it reads as melted clay, and the snow on the ridge looks like combed fur, not wind-packed snow
issues.fix: rebuild the spire as hard, jointed granite with sharp ledges and cracks, with snow lying on ledges and packed into smooth, wind-sculpted drifts on the ridge

issues.where: light on the spire's right face
issues.what: the warm low sidelight that turns the rock faces amber against cold blue shadow is missing; the rock is flat, evenly lit and grey-mauve
issues.fix: bring back a low warm key from the sunset side so the lit faces glow orange-tan and the shadowed faces drop to cool blue

issues.where: the far spires and the cloud sea, right half
issues.what: the distant peaks are smooth curved horns trailing streamers, not jagged rock needles, and the sea of cloud below the ridge has become a hazy grey slope of terrain; the sense of standing far above the cloud is lost
issues.fix: make the far peaks jagged needles that fade into haze, and fill the lower right and left with a dense, lit cloud sea well below the ridge

issues.what: the bolt is bright white, thin and branching like a stock overlay, sits higher and further left, and lights neither the cloud around it nor the spire it strikes; -a has a violet bolt glowing inside the cloud with a purple bloom at the strike point
issues.fix: tint the bolt violet, set it inside the cloud mass with glow in the cloud behind it, and add a violet flare where it hits the spire

issues.where: the streamers off the spire top
issues.what: the membranes are thin, flat white wisps and tiny figures; -a has broad translucent, glassy ribbons with a sheen and some torn pieces blowing loose top-left
issues.fix: widen them into translucent, iridescent ribbons that catch the light, and add loose fragments blowing off to the left

issues.where: the air around the spire and ridge
issues.what: there is no spindrift, blowing snow or mist curling off the rock, and the rain/snow veils on the left are gone; the storm feels static
issues.fix: add wind-blown snow off the ridge and spire edges, mist in the gullies, and dark precipitation veils in the left sky

issues.where: the cave mouth and the trail on the ridge
issues.what: the cave is a flat blue-black cutout with two smooth mounds in front and no depth or rock lip; the line of footprints leading to it is gone, replaced by a tiny figure
issues.fix: give the cave a rounded rock arch with depth falling into darkness, and restore the deep footprint trail climbing the snow to it

issues.what: the sky is a uniform lavender-grey; -a has deep slate storm cloud in the middle, a cool blue clearing at upper right and a thin band of bright orange right on the horizon
issues.fix: darken and separate the storm mass, open a cooler gap upper right, and narrow the sunset to a thin hot orange line at the horizon

issues.where: the snow and ice under the animal
issues.what: the ground is a smooth, glossy grey-blue sheet like plastic or still water; -a has gritty snow crystals, wet dark rock with ice glaze and a glistening meltwater channel in the foreground
issues.fix: give the ground crystalline snow and wet, iced rock with specular highlights, and keep the dark wet channel running through the foreground

issues.what: the spire and far peaks are pale, ghostly and evenly blue-white, almost like ice sculpture, standing sharp and close; -a has a tan rock spire softened by shallow focus and blowing snow, with the cave, the side spires and a sea of cloud beyond
issues.fix: warm the rock to tan-brown with snow on ledges, push it back with haze and lens softness, and restore the cloud sea and distant needles

issues.what: the lightning is gone and the bright orange horizon band is reduced to a faint reddish patch; the storm reads as a calm dusk
issues.fix: put back the violet bolt in the clouds at upper right and the hot orange band along the horizon under heavy slate cloud

issues.where: the air over the whole frame
issues.what: no blowing snow, spray or flying ice particles, and no shallow depth of field; everything is equally sharp and still
issues.fix: add wind-driven snow streaking across the frame and drift spray off the ground, and defocus the background

issues.where: the fur on the animal, centre and the dark flank (crops)
issues.what: the fur is built from flat cards with hard jagged alpha edges, and the dark flank is a black void with floating hair fragments; -a has dense frosted hair with ice rime and a soft rim light
issues.fix: render dense strand fur with frost crystals on the tips, fill the flank with lit hair or tissue, and add the cool rim light along the back

issues.what: the line of tracks leading in from the left is gone
issues.fix: add the footprint trail in the snow at left leading toward the body

issues.what: the rock is a flat, smeared texture with horizontal comb-like stripe artifacts and no relief; -a has sharp fractured rock with amber lit faces and thick hoarfrost feathers growing off the edges. The blur here is not motion on a fast thing, it is the surface itself breaking down
issues.fix: rebuild the face as jointed rock with ledges, amber light on its faces, and rime ice feathers along the left edge; remove the striping

issues.what: the far jagged peaks, the cloud sea and the violet lightning are all gone; there is only an empty sky over a flat orange plain
issues.fix: restore the receding hazy needles, the cloud sea below them, and the violet bolt at right

issues.what: the membranes are opaque white sheets with drawn veins, and there are fewer of them; in -a they are wide translucent, iridescent ribbons with water droplets hanging from frosted cords and a knot
issues.fix: make them translucent with a purple-gold sheen, add more ribbons, and put frost and hanging drops on the cords

issues.where: the pods on the cliff edge
issues.what: the pods are smooth dark lumps with no frost and fewer of them; -a has a long cluster of frosted, papery brown husks anchoring the cords
issues.fix: add more pods along the edge with frosted, flaking husks and catchlights

issues.what: no rain, drips, mist or blowing snow; the frame is clear and still where -a is wet and stormy
issues.fix: add fine falling drops and mist drifting between the cliff and the far peaks
